description: Behavioral fault-handling imported from v1: LLM retry/backoff and rate-limit queue semantics, plus rejection safety. The [FIXED] projection fault matrix (F1-F12) and spool kill matrix (S1-S8) are captured declaratively in matrix.json; their executable failpoint scripts are a registered gap (GAP-06).
